masteryZone.q: Which of the following is strictly an input device?
masteryZone.sol: A scanner is strictly an input device.

masteryZone.q: Which key is used to erase text to the left of the cursor?
masteryZone.sol: Backspace erases to the left; Delete erases to the right.

masteryZone.q: True or False: A touchpad on a laptop is a dual input/output device.
masteryZone.sol: False. It is purely an input device.

masteryZone.q: Which technology reads iron oxide ink on cheques?
What type of printer uses dry toner powder and a laser beam?
masteryZone.sol: Laser printer uses dry toner and electrophotographic drum.

masteryZone.q: Which device draws continuous vector lines using physical pens?
masteryZone.sol: Plotter uses physical pens to draw vector graphics.

masteryZone.q: True or False: A lower dot pitch results in a sharper monitor display image.
masteryZone.sol: True. Smaller dot pitch means closer pixels and sharper quality.

masteryZone.q: What is the speed unit of dot matrix printers?
Which of the following is a dual input and output device?
masteryZone.sol: Modem handles incoming (input) and outgoing (output) signals.

masteryZone.q: Which connector port transmits both high-definition video and audio in a single cable?
masteryZone.sol: HDMI carries digital video and audio signals together.

masteryZone.q: True or False: USB ports support hot swapping of peripherals.
masteryZone.sol: True. Devices can be plugged in or out while the computer is running.
